Chris is a business woman who works as a news reporter in the city. She works early in the day and is rarely in the valley, but will return late in the evening after her long work day. On Sundays, Chris will take the day off and can be found in the valley. She goes to the beach with her family, and then returns home. She has a secret hobby for fortune telling.  She is married to the sports enthusiast [[Wally (DS)|Wally]] and they have a son together, [[Hugh (DS)|Hugh]].
